name: holo-card-studio
title_zh: 3D 全息收藏卡网站生成器：草图或参考图进
tagline_zh: 不用碰 Blender 安装地狱，也不用手写 Three.js 场景。描述或参考图进去，分层立绘、视差材质。
tagline_en: Skip Blender setup and Three.js boilerplate. Drop in a description or image—layered art, parallax materials, and.
desc_en: Generate interactive 3D holographic collectible-card websites from a user description or reference image, using layered artwork, Blender and Three.js. Includes project-local Blender installation, reusable parallax materials and browser verification.
why_zh: 它把 Blender 装进项目本地，材质与视差逻辑做成可复用件，浏览器验证闭环。别人给你半成品。
why_en: Bundles Blender locally, ships reusable parallax materials, and verifies in-browser—so you get a playable artifact, not a.
limit_zh: 只认单张参考图或文字描述，不接多视角原画；产出是单页展示站，不含卡牌翻转逻辑、稀有度系统或后端存储。
limit_en: Single reference image or text prompt only; outputs a one-page showcase, no flip mechanics, rarity system, or backend. Needs Node; first run.
title_en: 3D holographic card site generator: sketch or reference.
